_comment: Copy to ~/.orderly/engines.json (or point ORDERLY_ENGINES_CONFIG at it). This file holds only what the gateway has no concept of: which tier a model has been reviewed for, what tool protocol it actually speaks, and each seat's effective context budget. Endpoints, credentials and model choice stay in the gateway's own openclaw.json.

ollama-cloud-openai/glm-5.2.note: Reviewed 2026-08-21: one tool call per turn, reliably.

local-ollama/llama3.1:8b.note: A 7B-class model on the operator's own box. It answers; it does not call tools.

researcher.note: Pointed at the local endpoint, with a budget that fits its 8k window beside its reply.
